journey.name: LC-06 An edited form survives process death and is not reloaded over
journey.description:
LC-04 kills the process over a create form, where there is no source value to lose. This is the harder half of NFR-07: an edit form has a task behind it, and TaskEditorViewModel must not fetch it again over the restored fields. The rule is one line - `if (!hasSavedForm) taskId?.let(::load)` - and getting it wrong replaces what the user typed with what the source still holds, which is the older of the two.
The seed ids are stable across a restart (FakeTaskApi hands out task-1 upwards from a fresh counter over the same SEED_TASKS), so the restored form is over a task that genuinely still exists and the save at the end is expected to land. ED-09 is the opposite case, where it does not.
`am kill` restarts the process with failureRate back at its 0.15 default, so it is set again before the save.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field contains "Renew domain registration"
Replace the contents of the "Title" field with "Renew it before Friday"
Using adb, kill the app process with `am kill com.rounds.test.to_dolist`
Reopen the app from the recents list
Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Renew it before Friday"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field still contains "Expires end of month"
Verify that the "Low" priority chip is still selected and "High" is not
Verify that "Due in 3 days" is still on screen
Using adb, set the failure rate back to zero with `am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 0.0`
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Verify that "Renew it before Friday" is the first row
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is not on screen
Verify that the "Renew it before Friday" row has an element with the content description "Low"
